_meta.facet: weapons: Legendary/Epic weapon catalogue with base stats and blueprint star (1-6) scaling
_meta.gameVersion: Live v3.0.7 (Sept 28 2026). Base stat sheet reflects the Once Human DB snapshot imported Mar 18 2026 (lReDragol) / Apr 30 2026 (saitoh183), i.e. v2.3.x; weapons released from v3.0.1 (Jul 9 2026) onward have names/effects but no stat sheet.
sources: https://github.com/lReDragol/OnceHuman_Tools (mechanics.py, player.py: star/tier multiplier model; weapon_list.json commit 2026-03-18)
https://www.oncehumandb.com/weapons/<slug> (upstream of both datasets; blocked from this session)
_meta.notes: Network egress in this session blocked every wiki/guide/Steam/official domain (fandom, wiki.gg, wikily, game8, oncehumandb, oncehuman.game, steamcommunity, reddit, archive.org ...). Numbers therefore come from (a) GitHub-hosted datasets that mirror Once Human DB (OHDB) and wikily, (b) search-engine result snippets of game8/wikily/fandom/Steam/paradoxgaming/vortexgaming pages (quoted in research/weapons.md), and (c) an Arabic/English news-research JSON that paraphrases the official 2026 patch notes. Two DMG scales exist in the wild: game8-style "base damage" (e.g. Bullseye 316, Last Valor 45) and OHDB/in-game Tier-V displayed DMG (Bullseye 1216, Last Valor 174); the ratio is a near-constant 3.82-3.88 across 12 weapons, so game8 values are read as Tier I. wikily/Gledson values (Last Valor 264, Critical Pulse 1812, Outer Space 192) are 1.517-1.524x the OHDB values, consistent with OHDB = 1-star and wikily = 6-star under the +10%/star model (1.5x) but NOT proven. Percentages are plain numbers meaning percent; baseWeakspotMult = 1 + baseWeakspotDmg/100 is an interpretation (weakspot hit = DMG x (1 + Weakspot DMG%)), not sourced text. Crit/weakspot values are the weapon-card bonuses (e.g. AR 6% crit rate, 27% crit DMG, 60% weakspot DMG) and were confirmed identical between the datamined list and wikily for 7 weapons.

starScaling.description: Blueprint stars (enhancement tiers) raise a weapon's displayed DMG (and HP/Psi Intensity on armor); they do not change fire rate, magazine, crit or weakspot stats (fandom: "Blueprint enhancement tiers increase the DMG stat of weapons across all their blueprint tiers; the number of stars a blueprint has indicates its enhancement tier"). Max 6 stars for Legendary blueprints; 6-star existed at launch (July 2024) - paradoxgaming: "When Once Human launched, reaching six-star weapons and armor felt nearly impossible ... leveling a legendary blueprint from one to six stars requiring 29,600 experience". Dec 2024 added the Blueprint Conversion System (transfer stars between blueprints). v2.3.4 (Mar 11 2026, preview) / v2.3.5 (Mar 25 2026): blueprints are activated directly with Starchrom, no fragment collection step (vortexgaming). The exact per-star DMG multiplier is NOT published anywhere reachable; the table below is the model hard-coded in the lReDragol community calculator (Mar 2026) and must be treated as unverified. Anecdotal Steam tests disagree (roughly +4% per star; 1-star vs 3-star Tier-I SOCR "about 10-15%").
starScaling.dmgMultiplierSource: https://github.com/lReDragol/OnceHuman_Tools portable_calc_v2/data/menu/calc/mechanics.py line 1213: star_multipliers = {1:1.0,2:1.1,3:1.2,4:1.3,5:1.4,6:1.5} (community model; applied multiplicatively to all PROGRESSION_SCALING_STATS incl. damage)

alternativeEstimates.basis: Steam discussion "Is there any noticeable difference between 3 star and 4 star weapons?" - a player estimated ~4% damage per star
Steam "Blueprint upgrading" thread: 1-star vs 3-star Tier-I SOCR tested, "about 10-15%" / "slight increase ... nothing game-changing"

wikily displayed DMG / OHDB displayed DMG for Last Valor (264/174), Critical Pulse (1812/1192), Outer Space (192/126) - consistent with 6-star/1-star = 1.5 if wikily shows max-star values (unconfirmed)

starScaling.maxStarsByRaritySource: lReDragol player.py max_stars table (community calculator; unverified in game - only the Legendary 6-star cap is corroborated by paradoxgaming/Steam)
starScaling.xpPerStarSource: https://paradoxgaming.net/gamearticle.php?id=sixstarblueprints (via search snippet) and Steam thread 4631485178655577294 snippet ("29,600 XP")
starScaling.tierMultiplierSource: lReDragol mechanics.py level_multipliers (community model). CONFLICTS with the observed game8 (Tier I) vs OHDB (Tier V) displayed-DMG ratio of ~3.85x; the in-game tier I->V jump is far larger than +20%. Treat as unreliable.
starScaling.calibrationModel: lReDragol model: calibration levels 0-6 add +2% each (0,2,4,...,12%) - unverified community model
starScaling.otherEffects: Armor: stars raise HP and Psi Intensity ("The higher the number of stars, the higher the HP and PSI intensity you get from gear pieces, and for weapons, their base damage receives a boost" - gamersandgeek). Weapon stars also raise weapon-mod-slot? No - unchanged. Tier V blueprints unlock at character level 40 (fandom).
starScaling.sixStarIntroduced: Present at launch (July 9 2024) for Legendary blueprints per paradoxgaming; no patch note found that added a 6th star later.

classDefaults._note: Weapon-card base bonuses per platform ("frame") from the datamined list; crit/weakspot are percent bonuses. A class default is the modal frame value; ranges show other frames in the same class. Values confirmed identical on wikily for SOCR, Critical Pulse, MPS7, ACS12, AWS.338, DB12, FP9/TEC9, G17 and R500.
